title: Crosstalkify
description: April fools mod that adds crosstalking, diamond pressure plates and some decorative bushes to the game...
body:
[![Partner](https://i.imgur.com/LR7NbVd.png)](https://bit.ly/3FodDXy)
## WARNING 
### This mod was very rushed to get done in two days. The mod therefore has very crude implementations that are very buggy sometimes. Please do NOT use this in any redstone-active worlds before making a backup!!

This is a mod i made for my 2025 april fools youtube video, which adds crosstalking, diamond pressure plates and some decorative bushes to the game...

The mod has a couple of commands to customize the behaviour of the crosstalking mechanic. These are the commands:

```
/aprilfools ct_chance (to change the chance that a wire will crosstalk)
/aprilfools ct_duration (to change the duration that a wire will crosstalk for)
/aprilfools ct_strength (to change the signal strength that a wire will crosstalk with)
```
